description: Live component documentation for SFE (@sfe/react-*), Fluent Copilot (@fluentui/react-copilot), and Fluent UI v9 (@fluentui/react-components). Use `ask_fluent_agent(<catalog>, <question>)` where <catalog> is one of `sfe`, `react-v9`, `react-copilot`.

tools.name: ask_fluent_agent
tools.description: Query the Fluent Agent for live component docs. Args: (catalog: 'sfe' | 'react-v9' | 'react-copilot', question: string). Prompt template: 'For {Component}: when to use, when NOT to use, do\'s, don\'ts, required/optional props and slots, default values, supported values, and a code example.'

notes: This is a template — replace `command` and `env` with the values your team uses to invoke the Fluent Agent MCP server.
Cosmo retries each MCP call once on transient failure, then falls back to the local `using-sfe-components` catalog and clearly marks the uncertainty.
